notes.title: Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
We were able to produce 5 different donuts in the donut making area. Now we can produce 11 different donuts!

We now have a new beverage cabinet. And it consists of 3 shelves. You will be able to stock more drinks

When throwing trash in the trash can, you had to get very close to it. Now it is easier

We could not click on the cash register screen to sit at the cash register. Now you can sit at the cash register by touching the cash register screen

The appearance of the cash register screen has been changed

The animations for arranging products on the shelves have been improved

The model for Iced Coffee and Water has been changed

Shadow quality has been improved

Lemon Soda and Cherry Juice drinks have been added

The quest update issue has been completely resolved

There were areas in the game that did not have language translations. The translation of all areas has been completed. If you see areas with missing translations, please let us know

notes.title: Bug fixes and optimization
notes.content: Fixed an issue with customers queuing at the cash register. Added a new coffee model. Fixed some issues that negatively impacted FPS and improved gameplay

notes.title: The user interface has been revamped and gameplay has been improved
notes.content: We have completely revamped the user interface and increased the feel of the gameplay mechanics.

notes.title: Task update bug fix and additional features
notes.content:
The problem with mission updates has been solved
We can now use the computer by clicking the left mouse button
We can now rotate furniture with both the R key and the mouse scroll
The feature of hiring a cleaner has been added to the Staff screen

If you experience problems after the update, you can open a new game.

notes.title: Tutorial, Bug Fix and Optimization
notes.content:
Added a section explaining the basic mechanics at the beginning of the game
Fixed some bugs in the donut production area
Solved the issue of not being able to put the tray in place in the donut production area
Solved the issue where the cabinets would sometimes fit into the glass and wall
There were people who had problems finishing the day with the car at the end of the day. We made a fix for this and fixed the issue

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
1- Added icons to product categories
2- Added information on donut production
3- Added animation when arranging donuts
4- Solved the problem of donut dough not being renewed when the day changes

notes.title: "Next Fest" Update
notes.content:
New customer character models have been added

Several issues related to donut production have been fixed

Optimization and graphical improvements have been made

The task system has been updated

notes.title: There is now a fine for leaving litter on the street
notes.content: With the new update, if you leave trash on the streets, you will be fined for the day. If you don't want to pay $10 for every trash you leave, throw all your trash in the trash before you finish the day

notes.title: New Update Notes
notes.content: The day will no longer end automatically at the end of the game. You can finish the day with your special vehicle. Also, a new donut cabinet has been added to the game. Player speed has been increased.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: Some bugs that occurred while producing donuts have been fixed. Some issues with mission updates have been fixed. After the update, you can open a new game and test it. If you have problems with the mission update, you can go to the main menu and reload the game.

notes.title: Make your own donuts and hire cashiers
notes.content: Today we will be releasing a big update. With the new update you will be able to make your own donuts and hire cashiers. Also new donuts and drinks are waiting for you!

notes.title: Our demo will be live within the day!
notes.content: Are you ready to start selling donuts? Our demo will be live during the day!

notes.title: Bug fixes and Donut decoration
notes.content: Fixed some bugs related to picking up objects from the floor and arranging them on shelves. Added donut decoration to the walls in the store.
